$comment: Actipass settings shown in the desktop app. One entry per setting of LoadSettings.m (ActiPASSV2); defaults come from LoadSettings, not from here. Labels, choices, limits and help follow ActiPASS_Options_GUI.mlapp, ActiPASS_Options_Calf.mlapp and ActiPASS_GUI.mlapp (2026.11.3). page: where the app shows the field (settings, data, process, stats). statsGen: the choices of the main GUI's statistics panel, made again for every stats run (Statistics page); the Options dialog's stat options are on the Settings page. propass: still editable in ProPASS mode. showIf: {key, in|notIn: [values]}. fields.label: ID format
fields.help: How IDs are found from file names: start, end or the special 'activpal' format.

fields.label: ID length
fields.help: Length of the ID digits or ID string. Only used when the ID format is 'start' or 'end'.

fields.label: Inside-out (flipped)
fields.help: Set if accelerometers are placed inside-out compared to Actipass defaults.

fields.label: Upside-down (rotated)
fields.help: Set if accelerometers are placed upside-down compared to Actipass defaults.

fields.label: Trunk accelerometer
fields.help: Turn on trunk accelerometer processing and set the placement (front or back).

fields.label: File name prefix
fields.help: Prefix of the trunk file name relative to the thigh file name.

fields.label: File name suffix
fields.help: Suffix of the trunk file name relative to the thigh file name.

fields.label: Inside-out
fields.help: Device placed inside-out compared to Actipass defaults.

fields.label: Upside-down
fields.help: Device placed upside-down compared to Actipass defaults.

fields.label: Calf accelerometer
fields.help: Turn on calf accelerometer processing (kneeling detection).

fields.label: File name prefix
fields.help: Prefix of the calf file name relative to the thigh file name.

fields.label: File name suffix
fields.help: Suffix of the calf file name relative to the thigh file name.

fields.label: Inside-out
fields.help: Device placed inside-out compared to Actipass defaults.

fields.label: Upside-down
fields.help: Device placed upside-down compared to Actipass defaults.

fields.label: Auto flip/rotation
fields.help: Let Actipass correct orientation problems automatically (force) or only warn.

fields.label: Auto trim
fields.help: How non-wear time at the beginning and end is trimmed.

fields.label: Calibration method
fields.help: Accelerometer device calibration method.

fields.label: Add autocalibration data to the calibration file
Thigh reference position
fields.help: Individual reference position (calibration) method.

fields.label: Lying algorithm
fields.help: Lying detection algorithm to use.

fields.label: Sleep algorithm
fields.help: How the sleep algorithm is run.

fields.label: Time-in-bed algorithm
fields.help: How time-in-bed (the time spent in bed, as the primary lying container of ActivPAL) is found.

fields.label: Cadence algorithm
fields.help: Cadence (steps) detection algorithm.

fields.label: Intensity algorithm
fields.help: How intensity is calculated: postures only, or raw accelerometer data and postures (R module). raw+posture is experimental: check its results before you use them.

fields.label: Trim filter: ignore non-wear shorter than
fields.help: Auto trim only (quality check): decides where the start and end of a recording are trimmed off; does not change the non-wear in the results.

fields.label: Trim filter: minimum active period
fields.help: Auto trim only (quality check): decides where the start and end of a recording are trimmed off; does not change the non-wear in the results.

fields.label: Trim filter: buffer
fields.help: Auto trim only (quality check): decides where the start and end of a recording are trimmed off; does not change the non-wear in the results.

fields.label: Non-wear correction for time-in-bed
fields.help: Sensitivity of non-wear detection during time-in-bed. Used for both the quality check non-wear and the non-wear in the final output.

fields.label: Max upright time within time-in-bed
fields.help: Upright periods (standing, walking etc.) shorter than this do not end a time-in-bed, e.g. a short visit to the bathroom at night. Also used by the lying and extra non-wear corrections.

fields.label: Minimum time in bed
fields.help: A time-in-bed must last at least this long; shorter lying periods are not times-in-bed. Also used by the lying and extra non-wear corrections.

fields.label: Very long sit time in time-in-bed
fields.help: auto2 only: sitting periods longer than this can be part of a time-in-bed (e.g. sleeping semi-upright). Also the minimum time-in-bed length when a time-in-bed does not start or end with lying.

fields.label: Trunk reference position
fields.help: Automatic, diary based or default reference positions for the trunk.

fields.label: ForceSync (skip trunk data if synchronisation fails)
Merge non-wear with thigh
fields.help: Merge trunk non-wear with the thigh non-wear (no activity while the trunk accelerometer is removed or off). Only takes effect when Lying algorithm is 'trunk'.

fields.label: Save trunk angle data
fields.help: Save trunk inclination data in daily and interval based formats.

fields.label: Try to correct orientation
fields.help: Try to correct upside-down problems automatically.

fields.label: Calf reference position
fields.help: Use diary based reference positions for the calf or not.

fields.label: ForceSync (skip calf data if synchronisation fails)
Merge non-wear with thigh
fields.help: If set, no activity is produced while the calf accelerometer is removed or off.

fields.label: Try to correct orientation
fields.help: Try to correct upside-down problems automatically.

fields.label: Too much kneeling warning above
fields.help: Kneeling outlier detection threshold (per day).

fields.label: Valid duration
fields.help: Minimum wear time of a valid day. Shorter days are flagged NotEnoughWear; a file without a valid day is NotOK. Also the wear-time threshold of the valid day criteria in statistics.

fields.label: Minimum walking
fields.help: Valid days with less walking than this are flagged NoWalking (QC status Check).

fields.label: Maximum 'other'
fields.help: Valid days with more 'other' activity than this are flagged TooMuchOther (QC status Check).

fields.label: Maximum stair walking
fields.help: Valid days with more stair walking than this are flagged TooMuchStair (QC status Check).

fields.label: Sleep interval check
fields.help: Consider the no-sleep-interval flag in the final QC status.

fields.label: Visualizations
fields.help: With 'QC', quality check figures and files for the batch are saved. With 'full', additional individual quality check figures, histograms and pie charts are made.

fields.label: Generate pie charts
fields.help: Daily and domain specific activity pie charts.

fields.label: Show diary comments in figures
fields.help: Show diary comments in QC figures next to event markers.

fields.label: Histogram: minimum day duration
fields.help: Days shorter than this are left out of the histograms.

fields.label: File exclusion
fields.help: Participant-level exclusion based on the QC_Status column of the master QC table.

fields.label: Valid day criteria
fields.help: Valid days according to ProPASS criteria, or only by wear time.

fields.label: Days to generate stats for
fields.help: Number of days N for which stats are generated. With more valid days, days are picked as set below; with fewer, the table is padded with NaN columns.

fields.label: Day selection
fields.help: First valid days, or optimal work/leisure days as one continuous window or as separate days.

fields.label: Stat domains
fields.help: Domains for stat generation, separated by spaces. Names should match the diary events.

fields.label: Diary matching
fields.help: Strict: exact matches. Inclusive: events containing the domain name ('Work' matches 'Work', 'WorkFromHome', 'WorkCommute').

fields.label: Treat diary time-in-bed as leisure
fields.help: Treat diary Bed/Night as leisure if Bed/Night is not given as a stat domain.

fields.label: TAI filter
fields.help: Filter the Thigh Activity Index before energy intensity classification.

fields.label: Walk MET
fields.help: Fixed cut-offs for slow and fast walking, or the height-adjusted curvilinear cadence-MET equation (regression; height 170 cm unless personal data are used).

fields.label: Use personal data
fields.help: Use a personal data table (SubjectID, Age, Sex, Height, Weight), chosen on the Statistics page: the height of each person in the cadence-MET regression (Walk MET: regression).

fields.label: Individual RMR for raw+posture
fields.help: raw+posture intensity algorithm: 1 MET of the PAEE intensity cut-offs is the person's resting metabolic rate (Mifflin-St Jeor: age, sex, height, weight) instead of 1 kcal/kg/h. Persons with incomplete data keep the fixed cut-offs.

fields.label: Bouts
fields.help: Generate variables for bouts of postures and intensity classes.

fields.label: Bout threshold
fields.help: Threshold used in detecting bouts of various length. 0 disables bout thresholds.

fields.label: Bout break
fields.help: Maximum break allowed within bouts, for all bout lengths including the 1-min bouts (0 disables).
